subject.title: fix(auto-reply): older completed replies stall or vanish when a follow-up message starts a long turn

question: Should foreground reply freshness fail open after 20 seconds when a newer same-session turn remains active but has not delivered a visible response?
rationale: The patch fixes a demonstrated indefinite hold, but the timeout deliberately changes the existing delivery contract from waiting for a potential newer winner to preserving the completed older reply after a finite settlement period.

options.title: Accept the bounded settlement policy
options.body: Merge the 20-second fail-open rule, preserving stale cancellation only when a newer visible reply arrives within that window.

options.title: Keep strict newer-turn suppression
options.body: Do not merge this behavior change and instead pursue a different fix that preserves indefinite suppression without parking completed deliveries.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded settlement policy
recommendation.body: Merge the 20-second fail-open rule, preserving stale cancellation only when a newer visible reply arrives within that window.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the closely related foreground admission and reply-freshness invariant.
